output.reason: Mild scratchy throat for one day with reported no fever and no trouble swallowing; the request for symptom relief is met by supported OTC guidance, so no clinician task remains now.
output.patientMessage: You can manage this at home: lozenges, plenty of fluids, gargling, and an over-the-counter pain reliever per its label often ease throat irritation. Mild one-day scratchiness without fever or swallowing trouble usually settles on its own. Message us if the sore throat lasts more than a couple of days, or you develop fever, pain on swallowing, or feeling very unwell. Get emergency care for trouble breathing, drooling, or inability to swallow.
